sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Successful save with conflicts resets the retained editor to initial defaults
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: After mutateAsync resolves, the page clears dirty, stores result.id and conflicts, then calls discardDraft(). That hook removes storage AND resets value to initialRef.current. When conflicts are nonempty the page deliberately does not navigate, so the visible retained form becomes the blank initial form with default climate_on rather than the graph just saved. The discard operation is not storage-only.
sourceConfirmedFindings.conditionalImpact: Requires an actual successful response containing conflicts. The source-defined branch is confirmed; backend conflict production and mounted reset were not exercised.
sourceConfirmedFindings.suggestedBoundedFollowup: Parent may reserve the page and its existing test for storage cleanup that retains the successful canonical form when staying in the editor; preserve conflict visibility and success-only transitions. Do not change the shared draft API without ownership.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Editing the rendered first trigger replaces a multi-trigger graph with a single trigger
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: Hydration, presets and AI apply preserve all triggers and formToPayload serializes them all, but only form.triggers[0] is exposed. Both trigger-kind changes and TriggerConfigurator onChange replace the complete triggers array with one element. Untouched additional triggers survive save; changing the first removes them without review.
sourceConfirmedFindings.conditionalImpact: Requires a valid existing/preset/proposed graph with multiple triggers. Such arrays are source-supported, but no actual preset, response or provider was read and backend multiplicity policy was not inferred.
sourceConfirmedFindings.suggestedBoundedFollowup: Parent resolves supported multiplicity with the integration owner, then reserves a precise preservation fix or explicit unsupported-shape review. Do not silently discard additional source triggers.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Readiness and imperative validation do not validate most condition contracts
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: conditionsReady and validate() check only missing geofence IDs. The default condition_other_automation has other_automation_id=0; its empty numeric input is min=1 but not required. Between fields can have missing/reversed bounds and are not required. These shapes can still produce Ready to save and proceed through the page's imperative validation. Native fields or the server may reject some inputs, but that is not equivalent to condition readiness validation.
sourceConfirmedFindings.conditionalImpact: An otherwise-ready draft with those conditions exposes the local guard gap. No server acceptance/rejection, invalid automation persistence or runtime command execution is claimed.
sourceConfirmedFindings.suggestedBoundedFollowup: Parent may assign explicit per-kind condition readiness and accessible validation under the existing wire contract, with covering cases. Preserve optional zero-condition behavior and valid signed SI thresholds.

guardAndActionContracts.draft: Version 1, 1500ms debounce; new/edit/preset keys are distinct. Persistence is gated on dirty, hydrated and no create/update pending. New drafts can be restored; edit/preset source hydration intentionally replaces restored data. useFormDraft key-switch and expiry handling inspected, not exercised.
guardAndActionContracts.navigation: useDirtyForm and useNavigationGuard preserve browser/in-app unsaved-work handling; explicit back/cancel awaits confirmDiscard when dirty. ConfirmDialog is rendered from discardDialogProps. This is a discard confirmation, not a publish/test-run confirmation.
guardAndActionContracts.lease: Page calls useEditLease and renders EditConflictBanner. The hook documents same-origin advisory election, not a server ETag/If-Match lock. Page does not use returned isOwner in save enablement. Cross-tab/server race prevention is not accepted here.
guardAndActionContracts.validation: Name, any trigger, geofence selections, any action, wait 1..3600 integer seconds, command-specific percent/current/15..30 Celsius inputs, notification channel/template, one typed setting value and positive called automation ID have explicit source checks. AB-QA-003 records the condition gap. Required/native custom JSON validity remains a separate browser mechanism.
guardAndActionContracts.review: The four OperationalBrief metrics and readiness are explicitly editor-only, not execution history. Geofence AI tool results are structurally narrowed, status ok enables Apply; Apply copies normalizers into the form and sets dirty only. The NL card streams text with onEvent no-op; no structured NL apply callback or direct persistence is implemented in that component.
guardAndActionContracts.nonSubmitAI: AIFeatureCard CTA and geofence Apply explicitly use type=button. The historical accidental enclosing-form-submit candidate is not repeated as a current defect.
guardAndActionContracts.save: Only explicit form submit invokes handleSave. Pending/presetUnavailable/non-live disable the visible Save/Create control. Imperative callback validates and awaits create/update; errors set saveError without marking success. Client live guard is authoritative even if an alternate submit reaches the callback. AB-QA-001 records conflict-branch form retention loss.
guardAndActionContracts.liveOnly: Create, Update and Test run specify requiresLiveMode:true and networkMode:always. request() calls assertOperationalWriteAllowed before any network attempt; environment-derived cached/offline and valid as_of reject non-read methods synchronously. networkMode:always is not offline queue permission. Page OperationalWriteNotice and disabled controls complement, not replace, the client guard.
guardAndActionContracts.testRun: Persisted-ID POST; success badge says Test run started, not completed. No dry-run, command safety, capability, authorization, or actual execution outcome is inferred from route registration.
guardAndActionContracts.AIRequests: Both AI draft paths use the existing specialized POST SSE hook, not request(). They propose locally and do not use create/update hooks. This stream transport does not carry requiresLiveMode; do not falsely extend the publishing live-only guarantee to every AI POST. Backend propose-only enforcement and confirmation continuation are unverified.
guardAndActionContracts.scope: null is an intentional all-vehicles business target, not missing numeric data. Header owns workspace selection; this fleet route disables its vehicle control, so retaining the form target selector is appropriate. AI workspace scope remains a separate source identity.
guardAndActionContracts.success: Dirty=false, savedId, returned conflict warnings and navigation are success-only. Save failure preserves form/draft. Test run toast/error is owned by the mutation hook; no success is fabricated locally.

trustUnitsAndPreferences.identity: Route automation ID, preset query key, lease key and draft key are source-specific. Form normalizers strip persisted step envelope metadata and retain canonical known typed fields, including numeric zero and false using !=null checks.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.retainedErrors: Automation, vehicles, channels and preset consume useDataState. fatalError alone replaces the edit source. StaleRefreshWarning is nonblocking beside retained payload; retry is per source. Vehicles/channels diagnostics do not hide their business editors, and fallback vehicle ID remains selectable.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.pausedUnknown: DataState distinguishes retained paused refresh from actual error; StaleRefreshWarning exposes data-refresh-blocked without asserting offline. Condition geofence initial non-fetching shows Unknown and preserves a missing selected ID. Trigger candidate remains separate. Missing numeric thresholds use null/blank, not measured zero.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.editInitialBranches: Edit initial loading/fatal/not-found can replace the unhydrated editor source. This is not a claim that ten form sections mount before edit identity is available. Preset status shell stays visible and blocks publication while unavailable.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.SI: Signal UnitInput and UnitListInput parse user display preferences into canonical values, then normalizers serialize those raw numeric fields. Known signal mapping uses m, m/s, Celsius, kPa, Wh and percent. Guided command temperatures store Celsius, charge limit percent, charging current A; wait duration_s stays integer seconds.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.legacyContractLimit: Existing geofence dwell_minutes is preserved verbatim by the normalizer/editor. It is a source-confirmed minute-named wire field, not evidence that every automation time field is SI. No backend unit contract migration, reinterpretation, rename, or whole-application SI certification is performed.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.signs: No abs/sign clamp or display conversion is introduced in graph normalizers. Numeric SI comparisons can retain valid zero/negative values; count/wait/current/temperature bounds remain domain-specific. Between-order validation is incomplete, not silently reordered.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.preferences: UnitInput uses current settings for display, snapshots settings while focused, parses canonical input, and does not rewrite values merely on preference display changes. UnitListInput follows the same focus policy. useSettings here provides preference data, not deprecated unit converters. Locale/precision/current unit roundtrip requires later runtime evidence.
trustUnitsAndPreferences.localization: Static headings, labels, readiness, controls and help keys use t(). User names/templates/preset and server/provider messages are not recased. Generated parser/API errors may remain raw text. Catalog presence, projections, non-English rendering, plural behavior and RTL are NOTRUN, not certified by seeing t().
trustUnitsAndPreferences.observability: No page RUM, sensitive console logging or new telemetry bootstrap was introduced. Existing request and stream owners remain unchanged. Actual traces, spans, SLO coverage and production privacy evidence are NOTRUN.
